pr_title: cloud: switch to AWS SDK v2
pr_body:
Mostly followed the guide for migrating from v1 to v2 - https://aws.github.io/aws-sdk-go-v2/docs/migrating.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/116320
Release note(build change): changes the AWS SDK version used
for interactions with external storage from v1 to v2.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/115628)

issue_context.title: Transition from AWS SDK V1 to V2
issue_context.body:
CRDB currently uses the [AWS SDK V1 for go](https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go) which does not support some features, for example [multi-region access points for s3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/feature-s3-mrap.html). 

CRDB already uses [AWS SDK V2](https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2) for some DMS integrations and testing.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
We standardize S3 and KMS access through V2 of the SDK and remove V1 of the SDK. We would need to migrate [s3_storage.go](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/28457a0ac0464f58fe617728139bd1134dbe75ca/pkg/cloud/amazon/s3_storage.go) and [aws_kms.go](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/28457a0ac0464f58fe617728139bd1134dbe75ca/pkg/cloud/amazon/aws_kms.go) plus tests over to the new SDK.


Jira issue: CRDB-34577

review_comments: ListObjectsV2 is actually a different underlying API request, so there might be behaviour changes/3rd party incompatibilities we'll end up learning about here.
There is no default region in v2 of the SDK, if region is empty then there is logic below to infer the bucket's region before constructing the client.

Potential follow-up: Is necessary anymore? It _looks_ to me like SDK v2 treats connection resets as retriable errors.  https://github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/blob/7d7814fd914825a22ad375a3f458ae4b81d77ce1/aws/retry/retryable_error.go#L118-L120

Unfortunately we don't have a test around this behaviour.
https://aws.github.io/aws-sdk-go-v2/docs/handling-errors/#api-error-responses error codes are now wrapped as smithy.APIErrors
There is no "default region" in v2 - https://aws.github.io/aws-sdk-go-v2/docs/configuring-sdk/#specifying-the-aws-region. If the region is empty we error out above as it is a required field.

FWIW, we document that you need to set region: https://www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/stable/take-and-restore-encrypted-backups.

But I wonder if we should (as a follow up), (1) make sure we actually respect the AWS_REGION environment variable and (2) understand be the behaviour of `default-region` in the past to see if there is a cheap way to avoid breaking KMS URLS that are currently working.
We may want to follow up and figure out if this is resulting in _another_ sha256 to be taken or if the same one used for singing is used.
